scope: Preventative source review only; no gameplay, FLE, checkpoint, supervisor, or campaign-evidence state was started, reset, reconnected, or changed.
source_evidence: Verified the checked-out HEAD is exactly 8e96d2b19ac3d9653760451f990582a6f707101a on main, matching origin/main and fork/main.

Reviewed merged PR #49, Bound service-visit input transfers: its merge commit is the verified HEAD; its six hosted checks (Python unit 3.10/3.12/3.13, research-export 3.10/3.12, and Chromium) completed successfully.

src/jev_factorio/planning/service_visits.py now computes free_stack as max(0, catalog stack size minus observed buffered input) and caps the generated factory_insert at that free space, as well as demand, spendable stock, and the existing 200-item ceiling. This prevents a partly occupied single native furnace-input stack from requesting a full additional stack.

The exact-head regression test test_service_input_delivery_respects_observed_remaining_native_stack_capacity sets a 50-item ore stack with 5 observed items and verifies a paid, allowed delivery of exactly 45.

The native Lua transfer guard in src/jev_factorio/lua/factory.lua independently requires target.get_insertable_count(item) to cover the requested quantity before removal, records a receipt only after transfer, rejects partial transfers, and rejects receipt replay. The focused exact-head suite passed 253 tests, including test_lua_transfers_conserve_items_and_reject_replay.

The retained fair-action safeguards require the original connected player/character binding, normal game speed, and no cheat mode; ordinary reach checks remain in both fair actions and factory transfers. The PR changes no fair-action code and introduces no inventory grant, remote interaction, or movement/mining bypass.
